title: A photo from another day, logged under a meal of today, leaves two dinners on its day
short: A meal is logged on one day, at the meal's time, set in one edit mode; the line says No meal selected
rel: Proposed; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
boardTitle: B150: a photo from another day, logged under a meal of today, leaves two dinners on its day

opportunity.from: Coach Milan, 18 November 2026, 19:21, with a screenshot of his Plan on Tuesday 17 November. Found while testing the last releases on his phone.
opportunity.job: Log a photo of a meal I ate on another day, to that day and that meal.
opportunity.kind: A wrong record, on two days at once. The day I ate it shows two dinners. Today's dinner counts as eaten though I have not had it.
opportunity.why_now: It is in the releases under test, and every photo picked from Your photos can end this way.

problem: I read a photo from Tuesday 19:56. I tried it as today's lunch first, then wanted its real time. The pencil's calendar showed a dinner at 18:00 and I took it. Now Tuesday shows Chicken and sweet potato fries as Dinner, 19:56, and under it the planned dinner, Chicken rice bowl, still asks I ate it, I skipped it.
story: When I log a photo from another day, I want it to land on one day, as the meal I picked, so that the day shows what I ate once and no planned meal keeps asking.
words: 18 November 19:21: the dinner around that timing was only possible for the time slot as planned in the calendar at 18h. And now we have two dinners. One as set from the read, and the one planned in the list.
cause: Two things together. The pencil's calendar opens on today, also for a photo from another day, so the Dinner you tapped was Wednesday's dinner. The meal was then logged with the photo's own time, Tuesday 19:56. One record held Tuesday's time and Wednesday's dinner. Tuesday lists it by its time; Tuesday's planned dinner is closed only by a Tuesday dinner, so it still asks.
proposed: Two states and one edit mode. The meal line has a small title, Meal and day. Under it: No meal selected, or the meal with its day and time. The pencil is always there. A tap opens edit mode and the pencil turns into the X that closes it; the X does nothing else. Edit mode is the calendar you know: it opens on the photo's day, with the photo's time as a reference that cannot be changed. If the photo carries only the time it was saved, the line says that. A tap on a meal sets it, saved at once, no Done. The time in that meal's row is a field: the meal's time in the calendar, for this meal on this day. A tap on the row No meal selected takes the meal off again. One rule where a meal is logged: its day is the day of the meal I set, its time is that meal's time in the calendar. And the plate's name, when it has none: grey Untitled plate with the pencil, in the space it has today.
repair: The record from Tuesday is still wrong on your phone. Proposed: when the app opens, a record whose meal is on a later day than its own time is moved to the meal of its own day. Yours becomes Tuesday's dinner; Wednesday's dinner opens again.

ac.title: No meal selected, said on the line
ac.text: Given a photo is read and no meal and day are set, when I look at the meal line, then it is the small title Meal and day, under it No meal selected, with the pencil and no Not counted, and the read ends with What do you do with it?.

ac.title: The pencil opens edit mode, the X closes it
ac.text: Given that read of a photo from Saturday 15:57, when I tap the pencil, then edit mode opens on Sat 14 with the row No meal selected marked and the pencil turned into an X, and a tap on the X closes edit mode and changes nothing.

ac.title: The photo's time is a reference, taken or saved
ac.text: Given edit mode for a photo, when I look above the days, then one line says The photo was taken on Saturday, 15:57. for a photo that carries its own time, and The photo was saved on Saturday, 15:57. When it was taken is not known. for one that does not, and a tap on the line does nothing.

ac.title: A meal is set and saved at once
ac.text: Given edit mode is open, when I tap Dinner, then Dinner is marked, the line says Dinner, Saturday, 14 November, 20:00 at once, edit mode stays open, and there is no Done.

ac.title: I change the meal's time in the calendar
ac.text: Given Dinner is marked, when I tap the time in its row and set 19:30, then the line says Dinner, Saturday, 14 November, 19:30.

ac.title: Only this meal, only this day
ac.text: Given I set Saturday's dinner to 19:30, when I open Slots and times or another day, then Dinner is at 20:00 there.

ac.title: Closed, the line keeps the meal and the pencil
ac.text: Given Dinner at 19:30 is set, when I tap the X, then under the title Meal and day the line shows Dinner, Saturday, 14 November, 19:30 with the pencil, the read asks Did you eat it?, and a tap on the pencil opens edit mode again.

ac.title: One dinner on the photo's day
ac.text: Given that read and a Chicken rice bowl planned for Saturday's dinner, when I choose All of it and tap Done, then Saturday shows my meal as Dinner, 19:30, the Chicken rice bowl no longer asks, and today shows nothing of it.

ac.title: Back to no meal selected
ac.text: Given Dinner is set, when I open edit mode and tap the row No meal selected, then the line says No meal selected again, and the read ends with What do you do with it? again.

ac.title: A meal of today, when I mean today
ac.text: Given edit mode on Sat 14, when I tap Sun 15, today and then Dinner, then the line says Dinner, Sunday, 15 November, and after All of it and Done the meal is today's dinner and Saturday shows nothing of it.

ac.title: One day per record
ac.text: Given a meal is logged from a photo by any way (the read, the plate, Ate it, edit mode), when I open the Plan, then it shows on the day of the meal I picked and on no other day.

ac.title: The record on your phone
ac.text: Given a record with the time Tuesday 19:56 and the dinner of Wednesday, when the app opens after the release, then it is Tuesday's dinner, Tuesday's planned dinner no longer asks, and Wednesday's dinner is open again.

ac.title: A plate without a photo
ac.text: Given a plate I built with no photo, when I tap the pencil, then edit mode opens on today with no line about a photo, and everything else is the same.

ac.title: A plate with no name says Untitled plate
ac.text: Given a plate with no name, when I look at its title, then it says Untitled plate in grey with the pencil, no line is added under it, and a tap on the pencil puts the cursor in the name.

ac.title: Just looking is gone
ac.text: Given any screen or line of Chef Mealan that says Just looking today, when I open it after the release, then it says No meal selected or speaks of no meal selected, and no screen says Just looking or Not counted for this state.

ac.title: Three languages
ac.text: Given the app in English, Serbian or German, when I walk steps 1 to 7, then Untitled plate, Meal and day, No meal selected and the two lines about the photo's time are in that language.

unchanged: The photo screen and the read, but for the meal line.
What do you do with it? Save it, Plan it, Ate it, and Ate it's calendar.
Did you eat it?, All of it, Half, Part of it, Done.
The days and the rows of the calendar, and What is it? and the kind of moment under it.
Slots and times in the settings.
A dinner logged after midnight stays with the evening before.
details: No new screen. The meal line and the calendar are the ones you know.
New in the calendar: the time in the set meal's row is a field, and one line with the photo's time as a reference, taken or saved. The row Just looking is named No meal selected.
New on the meal line: the small title Meal and day, and No meal selected when nothing is set. The pencil is always there.
New on the name: grey Untitled plate with the pencil. No line is added under it.
The app keeps where a photo's time came from: the camera's own record, or the file.
Frames 5 and 6 show Save in My recipes as a tick and Cancel left of Done. That row is DT307, drawn here so the flow looks as it will; B150 does not build it.
The rule sits in the one place a meal is logged, so every way obeys it. The repair touches only records whose meal is on a later day than their time.
The row B150.1 on this board, steps 1 to 7 and the two frames after them, is what it looks like.
The line under the title on the read, Read from your photo. Tap an amount to correct it., is changed by DT318, not here.
words2: 18 November 19:34: I couldn't change the timing; it was only the timing from the settings. 19:43: better an edit mode where what is needed is set, than another way of correction. 19:49: edit mode is when the pencil is clicked and turns into an X to close it; saved automatically, no Done. The time of the picture is a reference; what should be changed is the timing in the calendar. 20:12: the X was to remove the meal and the pencil to edit, so there is no proper solution for no meal selected. Maybe the default is the status Just looking, or select the meal. Without selection it is not counted. When selected, the meal with its timing is displayed. What we need is the way from a selected meal back to Just looking. And: draw the new flow whole, with the existing screens, and say which did not change. 20:28: make it more of a call to act, both the title of the Plate and Just looking. The name, when nothing is there: something like Untitled, edit or Mealan will name it. Not counted seems obsolete. 20:31, on Pick a meal and No meal: from where? what? 20:47: the line under Untitled takes space and Chef Mealan will name it is unclear for a cold reader. Put it on a day: what does it mean, why changed? Not on any day is also new; better wording. What if the photo's time is not known? Save in My recipes is solved differently now, with Cancel left of Done. 21:19: 1a to 1b transition? The long button right below the title does not cover the right thing. Maybe a title of the block, and below it No meal selected, with the pencil for edit. 21:26 to 21:31: Read from your photo sounds like a task; say Chef Mealan named it from your photo (DT318). The title: Untitled plate.
time_now: Once a meal is set, the pencil is gone. An X stands in its place, and it does not close anything: it takes the meal off. The line says Dinner, Saturday, 14 November, 20:00. The time is words, so it cannot be changed.
time_proposed: One icon, one edit mode. The line always has the pencil. A tap opens edit mode and the pencil turns into the X that closes it. Every change is saved at once; there is no Done. In edit mode: the photo's time as one line of reference, which cannot be changed; the days; the meals. The time in the marked meal's row is a field: a tap opens the phone's clock and sets the meal's time, for this meal on this day only.
more_change: Four things change that are built today, so you see them before a Go. 1. Meal and day not set and Just looking become one state. Its line says No meal selected under the title Meal and day; the row in the calendar says the same. The page ends with What do you do with it?, as today. 2. The X that removed the meal goes. The X only closes edit mode; the row No meal selected removes the meal. 3. A photo logged to a meal is logged at the meal's time in the calendar. Today a photo of that same day is logged at the photo's time. 4. The words Just looking leave the app: eleven lines say them today. Chef Mealan names it becomes Untitled plate.
days: The board is drawn on the app's test days. The photo is from Saturday 15:57: that is your Tuesday 19:56. Today is Sunday: that is your Wednesday.
